title: Information Shocks, Disagreement, and Drift
summary: Publisher403. Preserve EIA follow/fade failures; no timing or surprise proxy rescue.
about: Oil inventory news, disagreement and post-announcement price adjustment.
findings: Primary indexed text reports rapid good-news adjustment and roughly five-minute bad-news drift; not reproduced.
mechanism: Different trading horizons may delay incorporation of adverse inventory information.
